hazards.title: Unguarded floor opening
hazards.description: A large rectangular floor opening in the foreground exposing the cable vault below has no cover, guardrail or barricade, creating a fall-through hazard for workers walking the aisle.

hazards.title: Work inside open energized switchgear
hazards.description: A worker in the center is reaching into an open switchgear section with exposed breakers and terminals, with no visible lockout devices, barriers or arc-flash PPE.

hazards.title: Multiple switchgear doors left open
hazards.description: Several switchgear cabinet doors along the right-side lineup are open, exposing internal electrical components to passing workers.

hazards.title: Worker high on stepladder overreaching
hazards.description: A worker at the upper left stands near the top of an orange stepladder, reaching overhead into the cable tray with the body extended upward.

hazards.title: Extension cord across walkway
hazards.description: An orange extension cord runs loosely across the main floor aisle from the ladder area toward the right, creating a trip hazard.

hazards.title: No gloves during electrical work
hazards.description: The worker in the center is handling components inside the open switchgear without visible insulating gloves.

hazards.title: Materials stored near opening edge
hazards.description: Metal cable tray sections and other materials are stacked on the floor at the left, close to the edge of the unprotected floor opening, where they could slide or be knocked in.

hazards.title: Cluttered aisle along switchgear
hazards.description: Boxes, a cable reel, metal channel pieces, a tool case and carts crowd the floor along the switchgear lineup, narrowing the working clearance in front of the electrical equipment.

hazards.title: Loose strut leaning against equipment
hazards.description: Lengths of metal strut channel lean upright against the switchgear on the right and could topple onto workers.
